Fulgora science island based on the principle of bitter voiding.
By Emiliojose77

try to never run out of cars.

the mining site can be moved out of the middle if the resorces patch runs out, the train have enough time to travel far to another patch.

To place the bitters, put a rare bitter egg in the middle of the cars close to the train wagon. Sometimes they breake an underground belt when they spawn, but if car supply its constant, it will never break another thing again or despawn.
title: Fulgora island 105k science/min bitter voiding
